text:
Looking at this question: "top 10 products by revenue" — this is a ranking of products (grouped by product entity key, with product_name as display label) by revenue.

Per rule 8b, "Revenue" is a governed business term: product revenue from order_items excludes tax (metric:order_item.revenue), distinct from order total revenue which includes tax. Since the question says "products" (not "orders"), the product-level revenue metric is the correct governed default — no ambiguity to clarify since the term explicitly ties "product revenue" to order_items.

```json
{"version":1,"kind":"analytics","reading":"Rank the top 10 products by total product revenue (excluding tax).","measures":[{"ref":"metric:order_item.revenue","aggregation":"sum"}],"groupBy":[{"ref":"entity:order_item.product","role":"key"}],"display":["dimension:products.product_name"],"ordering":{"ref":"metric:order_item.revenue","direction":"desc"},"limit":10,"expectedShape":"ranking","unresolved":[],"provenance":{"metric:order_item.revenue":"q:revenue","entity:order_item.product":"q:products","dimension:products.product_name":"q:products"}}
```
